## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改测试。#33270 合并后 main 上的 Temporal Conformance(真 MySQL)红了一项:分析原生 SQL 那条测试把 MySQL 原始结果 `[rows, fields]` 当成行数组读,读出两个 undefined。改成和测试工具包相同的解包方式。
- 产品行为:MySQL 上的等值、范围过滤和读回在同一次运行里都是绿的,红的只有这条测试自己的读结果方式。

## What changes

`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-32851-date-on-instant-column.test.ts`: the file-local `rowsOf` now unwraps mysql2's `[rows, fields]` answer the way `live-dialect-matrix.testkit.ts`'s own `rowsOf` does (an array whose first element is an array → that element). +4/−1, test only.

## Tests

- main push run on `6a28a271`, job 132508312593 (Temporal Conformance, live PG + MySQL): `FAIL … live mysql (#32851) > the outside-the-builder filter door (analytics native SQL) answers the same day` — `expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 'created', 'era', 'updated' ]`. Every other MySQL and PG test in the file passed in that run, including the equality/range filter and the `datetime`-era read.
- Local (SQLite cell) at `a844fc88`: `vitest run src/sql-driver-32851-date-on-instant-column.test.ts` → 5 passed, 4 skipped (the PG/MySQL cells; no servers here).
- NOT MEASURED before merge: the MySQL cell. Temporal Conformance runs on push to main only, so the post-merge main run is the reading; I will check it.
